title: Don’t waste your money
text:
Don’t waste your money. They smell great when you first put them into your melting device, but the scent does not last very long.
I will not purchase again and I would not recommend.

features: ALL NATURAL 100% SOY WAX- Our hand-poured scented wax candle melts contain100% soy wax, making them bio-degradable and eco-friendly. Our melts are completely free of all toxins, leaving the air you breathe much healthier for you and your family.

STRONG, LONG LASTING SCENTS- Our candle wax melts are loaded with scent to the absolute maximum recommended level for intense fragrance. Cut each melt into 4 equal parts. Simply place a quarter melt into any wax warmer to rapidly fill the room with fragrance within minutes. You can add more for large open rooms. Each burn will provide about 40 hours of strong scent throw providing many hours per variety pack!
